children: U.S. commercial landscaper's Q4 revenue declined 3.6% and missed analyst expectations
Company repurchased 1.2 mln shares in Q4, 4.1 mln for the year
BrightView sees FY27 Land Maintenance revenue of $1.763-$1.780 bln, up 3%-4%
Company expects FY27 Snow Removal revenue of $210-$230 mln
BrightView forecasts FY27 Development Services revenue of $572-$715 mln
MAINTENANCE GROWTH - Q4 maintenance services revenue rose due to higher commercial landscape contract and ancillary services
DEVELOPMENT WEAKNESS - Q4 development services revenue declined due to lower project volumes and changes in project timing and mix
COST PRESSURES - Higher fuel prices and increased salesforce investment weighed on margins
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the environmental services & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for BrightView Holdings, Inc. is $15.00, about 26.6% above its November 9 closing price of $11.85
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 18 three months ago
